Paper should disclose survey weights and strata/PSU or complex survey limitations.
Paper should report sample construction and cohort counts.
Paper should discuss missingness or complete-case handling.
Paper should include at least three source URLs.
No obvious causal overclaim terms found.
Paper should explicitly bound observational/cross-sectional inference.
No obvious diagnostic overclaim terms found.
Companion evidence JSON should be readable.
Evidence should include row counts or eligible cohort evidence.
Evidence should include limitations or survey-design notes.
Logistic/binomial evidence should be reported with odds-ratio/logistic language.
Approximate weighted models should disclose non-design-correct variance limits.
Paper should disclose covariate adjustment groups present in evidence JSON.
Threshold-based papers should name threshold definitions and cite threshold sources.
Single urine albumin/UACR threshold papers should avoid CKD diagnosis and disclose persistence/repeat-testing limits.
Blood-pressure threshold papers should distinguish measured threshold status from clinical hypertension diagnosis.
